found.label: As found

risk.label: By risk
risk.axis: Worst first — where most audits stop
risk.verdict: By risk. Worst first, and still ragged: the top row is the heaviest job on the list, and the fourth carries the same risk for a fraction of the work.

sequence.label: Audit order
sequence.axis: Risk removed per unit of effort
sequence.verdict: Audit order. The bars fall as a staircase, because this is the only ordering the measure agrees with. It is also the only one you can start on a Monday.

register.honesty: These are the check classes a technical audit covers — not findings invented for a client who does not exist. Risk and effort are 1–5 bands, and the ordering rule is computed in front of you rather than asserted.

curve.description: A wrong architecture costs almost nothing to change while it is still a sentence, and almost everything once it is live. The audit is a flat line drawn across that curve at the only point where it is still cheap.

curve.figureAlt: The cost of changing the same decision rises across four moments — definition, architecture, build and live. The audit's fixed price is drawn as a flat line crossing it early, and a dashed line shows the same fee credited back to nothing if the build goes ahead.

curve.creditLabel: Credited to the build · nothing if you build it with us

The curve carries no numbers on its vertical axis, because we have not measured your system yet — and a chart that pretends otherwise is the thing this page exists to argue against.

webDesign.process: Design here is not a visual layer applied after the build plan is set - it is the build plan. We start from the user flow a real buyer takes, from first scroll to the action you actually want, and only then decide what each screen needs to say. That is why these systems hold up after launch: every spacing and contrast decision was made to support one job, not to look good in an isolated mockup. Identity, typography, and component states ship as a system your team can extend, not a one-off Figma file that drifts the first time someone edits it without us.
